title: Partition-function flip identity
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $f$ map sign vectors of length $n$ to signs, let $pi:bfntobfm$ be a coordinate map, and choose a sign vector $w$ of length $m$ and an index $j<m$. The uniform probability over sign vectors $z$ of length $n$ that the values of the partition function at $w$ and at the vector obtained by flipping coordinate $j$ differ equals the uniform probability over sign vectors $x$ of length $n$ that $f(x)$ differs from its value after flipping every coordinate $i$ for which $pi(i)=j$.
hypotheses_covered: a Boolean function on sign vectors of length $n$
a coordinate map from $n$ coordinates to $m$ coordinates
